works.title: Synapses Tour
works.event: Six cities (NYC/Atlanta/Austin/LA/Seattle/SF) then Burning Man 2005 Fire Dream Circle
works.interaction: Participants loaded meaning into cauldrons during scheduled burns
works.crew_model: six regional community workshops (NYC/Atlanta/Austin/LA/Seattle/SF) with Jaime Ladet; each city kept its cauldron
works.ritual: hexagonal grouping on playa; ritual loading; burn-as-social-synapse
works.description: Six workshops in six cities over six months with Jaime Ladet; each city built and kept its own fire cauldron; shown at BM 2005 in the Fire Dream Circle around Pepe Ozan's Dreamer (with Flaming Lotus Girls)

works.title: Contraptions
works.description: His 2007 BM installation literally titled 'Contraptions' — the direct root of contraptionism.com

works.title: Triple Bypass
works.aka: Quad Pass / Quadrapass (original name, renamed mid-build)
works.description: Fire cauldron begun as the "Quad Pass" (Quadrapass) and renamed "Triple Bypass" mid-build (a heart-attack joke). The first Burning-Man-represented artifact at the inaugural AfrikaBurn ("Africa Burns", 2007, at the Bijou in Observatory, Cape Town); a ~year-and-a-half effort. Charlie & Jamie Ladet toured the US building gift-economy fire cauldrons en route; workshop participants designed the sculpture's own symbol system (dragon-on-anvil, circle-in-square/infinity, lightning).
sources: AfrikaBurn 2007 film (Richard Gregory, yt d5flXmOp0-M) + transcript

works.title: 24/7 A Time Star

works.ritual: symbolism of sevens — days, planets, chakras, heavens, virtues, the sun

works.title: Uncle Charlie's Red Hot Cock
works.dimensions: 12'x30' base; 25-30 ft tall (50 ft per KK)
works.interaction: Two groups (30+) rock a giant teeter-totter ("ROCK THE COCK"); meat dropped through a chute, served at sunrise
works.fire_system: mechanical wood-fired cauldron; jackal-rooster spits flame
works.description: Jackal-headed rooster teeter-totter that burns wood; ~40 crew; 2-2.5 cords; KK was quartermaster/documentarian

works.title: The Solar Scope
works.description: Tuned mechanical sun/time device set on a 60-degree parallel; built with his cousin (a math artist)

works.title: The Burning Book of Brian
works.status: planned (independent; NOT an official BM honorarium)
works.interaction: Participants pump an LPG heart "heartbeat" under operator guidance; log-toss reload; procession
works.fire_system: hybrid wood-fired + LPG heart flame effect (up to ~20 ft)
works.crew_model: Charlie directs 2 operators + 8 assistants; 8-10 artists skin the pages
works.ritual: memorial procession; heartbeat pumping; page-inscription; Wednesday one-time burn
works.themes: memorial; pulsing heart; the royal we
works.description: Memorial effigy for Brian Doherty with a pulsing LPG heart; community-built; 8-10 collaborating artists; independent/community-funded (not on the 75-project 2026 honoraria list)

works.title: Fire Birds of the Fifth Direction
works.event: Burning Man 2011 (Great Circle, around the Man)
works.interaction: Congregation areas around the Man; transform into "ONE" for a Saturday eruption
works.fire_system: four 12-ft wood-fired cauldrons; internal fire lights cut patterns
works.ritual: night glow / day shadow-casting wings; final unification
works.themes: mythic birds; congregation; transformation into ONE
works.description: Four 12-ft wood-fired metal bird-creature cauldrons with cut patterns lit by internal fire at night and shadow-casting wings by day; surrounded the Man as congregation areas, transformed into "ONE" for a Saturday eruption. Same winged cut-panel design recurs at Okeechobee 2017.

works.title: Big Bully
works.interaction: Participants threw logs into the bull’s mouth "as sacrifice"
works.description: A fire-spewing, winged, human-headed bull; participants lined up to throw logs into its mouth "as sacrifice." Confirms the long-mislabeled portfolio image bigbullysm.jpg.

works.title: Infinite Infant and the Trail of Toys
works.interaction: Fire from the head; tows three older wheeled cauldrons
works.ritual: inner-child mythology; past works reused as living components
works.description: A steel dunce-cap-wearing baby pulling metal play toys and shooting fire from its head, towing three older wheeled fire cauldrons from previous work — Charlie treating past sculptures as living components of a longer mythology.

works.title: Big Charles
works.description: CANDIDATE WORK — surfaced via 4 Burning Man gallery photos titled "Big Charles" (several by photographer Shane Evans), one captioned "Big Charles and Galaxia". Relationship to other works (or whether a nickname) unconfirmed — verify with Charlie.

works.title: Encompassment / Directional Vessels of Fire
works.description: CANDIDATE WORK — surfaced via a Burning Man gallery photo "Encompassment / Directional Vessels of Fire by Charlie..." Details unconfirmed; likely a directional fire-cauldron grouping in the Synapses lineage — verify with Charlie.

works.title: Hamageddon
works.interaction: working pig-roaster / BBQ for the crowd
works.fire_system: wood/charcoal roasting chamber in the body
works.themes: functional fire art; pig roaster; community feast
works.description: A giant steel pig — a working fire/BBQ pig-roaster rig — its flank lettered "HAMAGEDON" (a ham/Armageddon pun), with gear-wheel hips and a mesh body housing the roasting chamber. Documented at a Prospect Park, Brooklyn festival roasting whole pigs for the crowd; Charlie's "feed and work with one another" ethos in functional form.
